column1: # Format: file <TAB> code <TAB> why absence means zero HERE.
# Keyed on the code, not the line number, so an edit above a row does not

# right reading -- "it is fine" is not one.

column3: Left-join miss: the unit is absent from within_day_var, which means it was counted once, so its within-day term is 0 and k_d is 1 (VAR-03). Only safe because read_supplied_within_day_var() refuses NA at entry, so the table cannot hold an unknown (#317).
Statistical claim, not a fallback: with no expansion component there is no shared multiplier error, so the covariance between groups genuinely is zero.
Second arm of the same claim, for the branch where the expansion carries no standard error.

Reached only under is.null(var_expansion_named): the design carries no expansion at all, so every group's contribution is zero rather than unknown. The NA-vs-absent case is handled in the else branch, which tests the key.
Left-join miss on the catch table: add_catch() documents that an angler who caught none of a species need not appear at all, so an absent row means zero caught. summarize_cws_rates().
Same reading, summarize_hws_rates(). The two functions are near-twins; a change to one belongs in the other.

Accumulator seed, not an absence conversion: the components are added on the following lines, and an NA in any of them propagates through `+` rather than being zeroed. A design with no components at all is refused earlier.

An interview absent from the catch table for this species caught none of it -- documented by add_catch(), and deliberately kept apart from a missing caught row alongside recorded dispositions, which means derive (#318).
